items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: Paul Ash was a great white band in Chicago. Oh, I have heard of the band.

ctx.x: Well, she was a colored girl from here. She looked like an Indian looking girl. But she, Paul Ash, they were the leading couple. You remember Paul Ash?
No, I'm afraid this is new to me.
